question: What have you been doing with your time this month?

raw:
I’ve been helping at the community kitchen on Thursdays, labeling the leftovers before they’re put away. It gives me a bit of a routine.

I’ve also been listening to recorded detective stories, both at home and on the walk to the kitchen. I like having a mystery to take along.
